summary.text: Jules Walters is a Democratic state representative from District 37 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
She appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: Jules Walters lives in West Linn, Oregon, and graduated from Palisades Charter High School in 1989.
She earned a bachelor's degree with a focus on communications and journalism from the University of Oregon.
Her career experience includes work as an administrative assistant, business owner and vice president of operations, and she served as mayor of West Linn.
